chunks.title: Electric Shock & Water Hazard
chunks.content: Never submerge the appliance or let the power cord contact liquid; unplug before cleaning or assembling/disassembling parts.

scenarios.condition: Cord or plug contacts water or is damaged
steps: Unplug immediately by grasping the plug body
Do not use appliance if cord or plug is damaged
Contact SharkNinja for servicing; do not attempt repair

chunks.title: Interlock and Paddle Safety
chunks.content: Never operate the appliance without the lid and bowl properly locked in place, and never place the paddle on the motor base unless attached to the lid and bowl; keep hands, hair and utensils out of the container during operation.

scenarios.condition: Attempting to bypass lid/bowl lock or run with hands near paddle
steps: Ensure outer bowl and lid are fully installed and clicked into place
Do not attempt to defeat the interlock mechanism
Keep hands, hair, clothing, and utensils away from the container while operating

chunks.title: Hot Liquids and Processing Restrictions
chunks.content: Do not mix hot liquids (risk of pressure buildup/steam burns), do not process dry ingredients without liquid, do not grind, and do not process solid ice, ice cubes, or loose frozen fruit as this is not a blender.

chunks.title: Cord, Plug, and Placement Precautions
chunks.content: Use only on a dry, level surface; never use an extension cord; do not let the cord hang over edges or touch hot surfaces; do not fill past MAX FILL or run with an empty container.

chunks.title: Utensil and Carrying Precautions
chunks.content: Remove all utensils from containers before operation to prevent shattering, and never carry the unit by the outer bowl handle — grasp both sides under the head instead.

chunks.title: Supervision and Accessory Restrictions
chunks.content: Not intended for use by those with reduced physical/sensory/mental capabilities without supervision; only use SharkNinja-provided or recommended attachments; keep children away from operation.

chunks.title: Parts List
chunks.content: The unit includes a motor base, outer bowl lid, Deluxe Creamerizer paddle, CREAMi Deluxe lid, 24 oz CREAMi Deluxe pint, and outer bowl; color, pint count, and programs vary by model.

chunks.title: Technical Specifications
chunks.content: Operates at 120V~, 60Hz and 800 Watts.

chunks.title: Before First Use Setup
chunks.content: Remove all packaging, wash containers/lids/paddle in warm soapy water (using a utensil with a handle for the paddle), thoroughly rinse and air-dry, and wipe the control panel with a soft cloth.

chunks.title: Freezing the Deluxe Pint
chunks.content: Add ingredients to the pint up to the MAX FILL line, snap on the lid, and freeze on a level surface for at least 24 hours; set freezer between 9°F and -7°F, and avoid chest freezers which get too cold.

chunks.title: Assemble the Unit
chunks.content: Plug in the unit first, then insert the paddle into the outer bowl lid (press latch, insert, release to secure), lock the lid onto the outer bowl by aligning and rotating clockwise, and place the outer bowl onto the motor base, twisting the handle right until it clicks.

chunks.title: Run a Processing Program
chunks.content: Press the power button, select a processing mode (TOP, FULL, or BOTTOM), then turn the dial to choose a One-Touch Program matching your base; the program stops automatically when done.

chunks.title: Remove Bowl and Serve
chunks.content: Hold the bowl release button and twist the handle back to center to lower and remove the bowl, press the lid unlock button and twist counterclockwise to remove the lid, then lift out the pint to enjoy.

chunks.title: Using Mix-In and RE-SPIN Programs
chunks.content: To add mix-ins, spoon a 1.5-inch hole to the bottom of the processed pint, add up to 1/4 cup of chopped mix-ins, and reprocess with MIX-IN; use RE-SPIN instead if the base is crumbly or powdery (never RE-SPIN before MIX-IN).

chunks.title: Leftover Pint Handling
chunks.content: Flatten the top of a leftover treat before refreezing; if hard after refreezing, reprocess on the original program, or add a pour-in (4 oz for Frozen Drink, 6 oz for Slushi/Creamiccino) before reprocessing drinkable leftovers.

chunks.title: Hand-Washing Parts
chunks.content: Wash containers, lids, and paddle in warm soapy water using a utensil with a handle for the paddle, then thoroughly rinse and air-dry.

chunks.title: Dishwasher Cleaning
chunks.content: Containers, lids, and paddle are top-rack dishwasher safe, but must be separated first and should not be cleaned with a heated dry cycle.

chunks.title: Clean the Outer Bowl Lid and Seal
chunks.content: Remove the paddle first, run warm water through the paddle release lever and out the drain holes, then remove the rubber lip seal from the underside of the lid and hand-wash or dishwasher clean both parts.

chunks.title: Clean the Motor Base and Spindle
chunks.content: Unplug before cleaning; wipe the motor base with a damp cloth only (no abrasive pads), and wipe the spindle below the control panel after each use; if liquid is trapped under the platform, raise it to clean underneath.

chunks.title: Storing the Unit
chunks.content: Wrap the cord using the hook-and-loop fastener near the back of the base (not around the bottom), and store attachments in a safe location away from damage or hazard.

chunks.title: Motor Overload / Error Codes E1, E2, E3
chunks.content: E1/E2 indicate motor overload requiring a 15-minute cool-down and clearing of jammed ingredients; E3 indicates an incomplete program requiring a paddle check and retry.

rows: Unplug, remove bowl, cool 15 min, clear jammed lid assembly, check ingredient density/temperature
Unplug, check paddle installed properly, retry

chunks.title: Install Light and Assembly Issues
chunks.content: A blinking install light means the outer bowl isn't installed correctly; a solid light means the paddle is missing or misinstalled — reinstall paddle, lid, and bowl until each clicks/locks into place.

chunks.title: Texture Problems (Liquid or Crumbly Treat)
chunks.content: If the treat is liquid, refreeze longer or lower freezer temperature; if crumbly or powdery, run the RE-SPIN program, and check that recipe fat/sugar ratios match recommended recipes.

chunks.title: Bowl Won't Release or Unit Moves/Vibrates
chunks.content: If the bowl won't release, wait 2 minutes and twist the handle with force while holding the release button; ensure the paddle cavity is dry to prevent freezing/sticking. If the unit moves on the counter, ensure the countertop and unit feet are clean and dry.

chunks.title: Pint Frozen at an Angle or Scratched
chunks.content: Do not process a pint frozen at an angle or refrozen unevenly — thaw in the fridge, whisk, and refreeze level; light scratching inside the pint is normal but avoid metal utensils and clean with soft cloths.

chunks.title: Freezer Temperature Requirements
chunks.content: For best processing results, set the freezer between 9°F and -7°F; RE-SPIN is often needed for very cold bases below -7°F.

tasks.title: Wash Removable Parts After Use
tasks.description: Wash the pint, lids, outer bowl, and paddle in warm soapy water or the dishwasher after each use.
tasks.justification: Leftover ice cream residue can harbor bacteria and cause odors if not cleaned promptly.
tasks.instructions_text: Wash containers, lids, and paddle in warm, soapy water using a dishwashing utensil with a handle for the paddle, or place the separated parts on the top rack of the dishwasher. Thoroughly rinse and air-dry all parts.

tasks.title: Inspect the Creamerizer Paddle
tasks.description: Check the Deluxe Creamerizer Paddle for bends or damage before each use.
tasks.justification: A bent or damaged paddle can jam the mechanism or cause the motor to overload during processing.
tasks.instructions_text: Before installing the paddle, visually inspect it for bends, cracks, or other damage. Contact SharkNinja for a replacement if damage is found.

tasks.title: Clean the Outer Bowl Lid and Seal
tasks.description: Remove the rubber lip seal from the lid and wash the lid and seal to clear stuck residue and drain holes.
tasks.justification: Sticky residue trapped in the paddle release lever, drain holes, or under the seal can clog the lid mechanism and cause it to stick or leak.
tasks.instructions_text: Remove the paddle, then run warm water through the paddle release lever and out the drain holes on both sides of the lid, positioning the lid lever-side down to fully drain. Remove the dark grey rubber lip seal from the underside of the lid and hand-wash or dishwasher-clean both the lid and seal.

tasks.title: Wipe the Motor Base and Spindle
tasks.description: Wipe down the motor base and the spindle below the control panel after each use.
tasks.justification: Food residue left on the spindle or base can dry and cause the bowl to stick or the unit to become difficult to clean later.
tasks.instructions_text: Unplug the motor base, then wipe it and the spindle beneath the control panel with a clean, damp cloth. If liquid is trapped between the base and platform, install the empty outer bowl and twist the handle to raise the platform, then wipe the exposed area with a damp cloth.

tasks.title: Dry the Paddle Cavity Between Runs
tasks.description: Dry the cavity on top of the paddle before processing and between consecutive runs of different bases.
tasks.justification: Leftover water can freeze between the paddle and motor base, causing the outer bowl to stick and become difficult to remove.
tasks.instructions_text: Before processing, and between processing consecutive bases, rinse and thoroughly dry the paddle and the cavity on top of it with a cloth.

tasks.title: Reset an Overloaded Motor
tasks.description: Perform the reset procedure if the motor overloads and displays E1 or E2.
tasks.justification: Running the motor without resetting after an overload can prevent the unit from operating or risk further motor damage.
tasks.instructions_text: Unplug the unit and allow it to cool for approximately 15 minutes. Remove the outer bowl lid and paddle and clear any ingredients jamming the lid assembly before reassembling and trying again.

re_check_triggers.description: Display shows E1 or E2 with program lights flashing

tasks.title: Level the Deluxe Pint in the Freezer
tasks.description: Verify the pint sits on a flat, level surface each time it is placed in the freezer.
tasks.justification: Freezing the pint at an angle causes uneven processing and the manual states such pints should not be processed.
tasks.instructions_text: Place the filled and lidded Deluxe Pint on a level shelf in an upright freezer (not a chest freezer) and leave it undisturbed for at least 24 hours.

re_check_triggers.description: Treat comes out unevenly frozen or crumbly after processing

weekly.title: Routine Cleaning After Use
steps: Wash the pint, lids, outer bowl, and paddle in warm soapy water or separate and place on the dishwasher top rack (no heated dry cycle)
Remove the paddle and run warm water through the lid's release lever and drain holes
Wipe the motor base and spindle with a damp cloth
Rinse and air-dry all removable parts before reassembly

deep_clean.title: Lid Seal Deep Clean
steps: Remove the paddle from the outer bowl lid
Run warm water through the paddle release lever and out the drain holes with the lid lever-side down
Remove the dark grey rubber lip seal from the underside of the lid
Hand-wash or dishwasher-clean the lid and seal separately
Ensure all parts are fully dry before reassembly

warranty.coverage: Covers defects in material and workmanship on the original unit and non-wearable parts for one year from purchase under normal household use, with repair or replacement at SharkNinja's discretion; a replacement unit's coverage extends 6 months from receipt or the remainder of the original warranty, whichever is later.
exclusions: Normal wear and tear of wearable parts (containers, lids, paddles, motor bases)
Units tampered with or used commercially
Damage from misuse, abuse, negligent handling, or failure to perform required maintenance
Products purchased, used, or operated outside North America
